en: SI:7 lockbox opens, sounding an audible alarm.
Your spirit is pure, $n.
Where is Elder Mistwalker?
How dare you!
Our preparations continue as planned, master.
Anything else I should know about the Earthen?
I'm here to retrieve your report.
You sorry sacks of maggot flesh can do better than that, now prove it!

See, the Venture Company's new shredder is better than my latest, from the interchangeable hands to the control grips! My boss has given me a pretty strict deadline, but my boys and I couldn't come up with anything.$b$bNothing was working, so we decided to "borrow" one of their prototypes. I sent Wizzlecrank to the Sludge Fen to steal one, but he hasn't gotten back yet!
I almost have enough supplies to upgrade our troops.
What now?  Can't you see I'm rather busy?
I've got my eye on you, $r.
I don't train your kind $c.
No, Ulathek. He knows your secret. He knows you plot with Lord Hel'nurath of Xoroth.
I crush weaklings like you every day!  Bring it on!
Aw! The captured sprite darters didn't make it. What will we do?
You must leave the bar!

You are not known to my people.  A kodo is a mighty steed, and it is the product of love and care by my people; such is not given onto strangers.  Until the elders of Thunder Bluff consider you to be exalted, I cannot offer you the sale of a kodo.
You are mine now children.  You will grow up to be a strong part of the horde!
It was the Lieutenants of Ragnaros, Geddon and Garr, who would perpetrate the betrayal against my Lord. Thunderaan was caught unaware.

I was searching for materials to build my latest and greatest invention, the portable remote control shredder unit, when these trolls clubbed me and dragged me into the depths of their cave.$B$BReturn me to safety and I will lend my aid to your cause, $r.
Where is Field Marshal Teravaine?
We don't take kindly to miscreants, $r.
Oh, here you are, Rockbiter! I'm sorry, I know I'm not supposed to wander off.
We must continue on now.
Sure, I'll tell you the phrase.  As long as I don't have to go anywhere near Tirth!
You cannot ride a mount in that form.

Hrm, curious... This ends abruptly. In Tanaris the Qiraji document facing a bronze dragon. There is much missing from this... More information must be found! Surely they are planning to invade Kalimdor once more!
Farewell to you, and may our ancestors be with you always!

This bear wanders a path close to where the Talondeep Path lies, due west of Mystral Lake and the Alliance outpost of Silverwind Refuge.  While he is the easiest of the three creatures you will face on the Ashenvale Hunt, he should not be trifled with.  His presence is a constant threat to travelers who sojourn between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains.
Yeah? Ye interrupted me, so ye better have a blasted good reason to do so.
The bell again, such a sweet sound.
If we can just hold them now, I am sure we will be in the clear.
There.  It is done.
Your voice is hoarse from yelling huh?  Find the Orgrimmar Auction House in the Valley of Strength.
I noticed some fire on that island over there. A human, too. Let's go check it out, $n.
I'm lucky to be alive!
Your message did reach us, Commander, but by no means is our involvement here sanctioned by the Grand Crusader.

Hail, adventurer. I am Rin'wosho, trader of Zuldazar. I come from the South Seas and bring many exotic goods and items from my homeland.$B$BPerhaps if you prove your worth to my tribe, I shall barter.  If you have any of my tribe's Honor Tokens, then perhaps we shall barter even more.
Tell me about the cannon.
I have lost my Ring of Unspoken Names. Are you able to replace it for me?
GOSSIP_OPTION_SPIRITGUIDE
Your blood shall be the catalyst for the Old Gods' return!
[PH] Ok, I'm outta here... see you in Ragnaros' Lair... l8
Come, $n. The lake is just around the bend.
What's going on here? Piznik! I knew we shouldn't have let you stick around!
Hey Vi'el, show me your wares!
The humans claimed much of the Dustwallow Marsh for themselves, but the Stonemaul clan, with our help, has been able to push them back.
Justice is done!
